description: c118 modding-pillar coverage: proves a .pdmod fixture placed in <install>/mods/ is detected by modmgrScanDirectory, validated by modmgrParseModJsonBuf, and registered into g_ModRegistry at boot. The fixture (tools/smoke-verify/fixtures/test_smoke_skin.pdmod) is a 500-byte zip with a single mod.json declaring id='pd2.smoke.testskin' and zero body/head/arena content -- the smallest valid envelope that passes the modarchive validator (deflate-compressed zip with root mod.json + M-2.3 zip-comment mirror) and the modmgrParseModJsonBuf validator (id field present). Run.ps1::Copy-SmokeFixtures stages the file at <installDir>/mods/test_smoke_skin.pdmod before launch via the fixtures array. The mod loads as enabled=0 (no mods-enabled.json entry); that's intentional -- the pillar contract under test is discovery + parse + registry insert at boot, not catalog hot-load. Asserts modmgr emits the canonical scan/discover/parse/scan-complete sequence with the fixture id surfaced in the log. Sister test for the modding pillar.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: vanilla --no-net boot, no scripted nav. modmgrInit() fires during gameInit() -> modmgrScanDirectory() walks ./mods/ and picks up the fixture .pdmod file. modArchiveOpen parses the EOCD + central-directory + reads mod.json into memory; modmgrParseModJsonBuf validates the id field (lowest validator bar -- empty buffer or missing-id would emit the WARNING line in our forbidden_patterns). Discovery completes before main_menu pushes, ~02-03s in.

scripted exit at 15s -- boot + modmgr scan completes by ~3s on a clean install (per the shared-install reference run); 12s headroom covers cold-start variance + asset catalog warm-up. modmgr: shutdown fires on exit which produces the SMOKE: result=scripted_exit sentinel.

forbidden_patterns: modmgr: archive '.*test_smoke_skin\.pdmod' could not be opened
modmgr: archive '.*test_smoke_skin\.pdmod' has no root mod\.json
